item.tib: tshe dbang bod yul ma yi shog chung
item.coloph: blo chung khong dge grogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ bdag 'dra go lam tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyis/ rmongs pa rnams kyi phyir du gzhan dang cha mthun shog chung bkod/ bka' la ra chod gyur pa'i nyes 'gal rnams/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro srung ma dang*/ mkhas grub gong ma rnams la mthol lo bshags/ dge bas 'gro kun bde chen sa thob shog/
